Hello! I'm a researcher, R educator, and computational scientist originally from Istanbul, Turkey, now based in Bar Harbor, Maine. My work focuses on systems genetics — integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data across genetically diverse mouse and stem cell models to understand how genetic variation shapes cell fate decisions, development, and disease. I also care deeply about building the next generation of computational scientists, and I teach R workshops and mentor students navigating the intersection of biology and data science.
